user.title: Connect SmartyPlants
user.description: Enter the API key from the SmartyPlants app, under Settings.

data_description.api_key: Create this in the SmartyPlants app, under Settings. It identifies your account to Home Assistant.

webhook.title: Enable live updates
webhook.description:
Optional: for instant updates instead of polling every minute, add this webhook URL in the SmartyPlants app, then paste the signing secret it gives you below.

`{webhook_url}`

Leave the secret empty to use polling only.

data_description.webhook_secret: The signing secret the SmartyPlants app shows after you add the webhook URL. It is used to verify that pushed updates really came from SmartyPlants.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect SmartyPlants
reauth_confirm.description: Your SmartyPlants API key is no longer valid. Enter a new one to reconnect.

data_description.api_key: Create a replacement key in the SmartyPlants app, under Settings.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SmartyPlants
reconfigure.description: Enter a new API key for this SmartyPlants account.

data_description.api_key: The API key created in the SmartyPlants app, under Settings.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SmartyPlants server. Check the address and your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: That API key was rejected. Check it and try again.

abort.already_configured: This SmartyPlants account is already set up.
abort.account_mismatch: That API key belongs to a different SmartyPlants account. Use a key for the account already set up, or add the other account separately.

state.no_sensor: Add a sensor in the app
state.no_plant: Add a plant in the app

invalid_auth.message: The SmartyPlants API key was rejected. Enter a new one to reconnect.

plant_without_sensor.title: {name} has no sensor
plant_without_sensor.description: The plant "{name}" has no SmartyPlants sensor attached, so it cannot report any readings. Attach a sensor to it in the SmartyPlants app. Readings appear here a few minutes later.

sensor_without_plant.title: {name} is not assigned to a plant
sensor_without_plant.description: The sensor "{name}" is not assigned to a plant, so its readings cannot be scored against a species. Assign it to a plant in the SmartyPlants app. Readings appear here a few minutes later.
